about.academic_text: Final project for course CSE703073 (topic ĐT-16). Data belongs to Naturalis under CC BY-SA 3.0; payments are simulated.
about.data_sources_text: Naturalis Biodiversity Center, Bioportal, Wikimedia Commons – CC BY-SA 3.0.
about.feature_analytics_text: Python finds tour drop-off points and recommends similar tours with TF-IDF.
about.feature_audio_text: Vietnamese and English (plus German, Dutch) MP3s for every gallery.
about.feature_guided_text: Next/Back, automatic transitions and highlighted hotspots per step.
about.feature_minimap_text: The floor plan shows your position, view direction and visited rooms.
about.feature_pano_text: Pannellum renders multi-resolution tiles smoothly on desktop and mobile.
about.feature_tickets_text: Cart, availability calendar, sandbox payment, QR tickets and invoices.
about.intro: BaoTang360 is a web-based virtual museum and 360° tour system built on open data from Naturalis Biodiversity Center (CC BY-SA 3.0).
about.persona_researcher_text: Read in-depth content, scientific names, catalogue numbers and Bioportal sources.
about.persona_student_text: Follow themed guided tours and track progress step by step.
about.persona_visitor_text: Explore freely, listen to audio guides and buy Regular or Premium tickets before a real visit.
about.personas_intro: Designed around three main user groups.
about.title: About BaoTang360
